entities.text:
Judicial Magistrate of First Class-I,
Parappanangadi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The offences alleged are punishable under Sections 498A, 406 and 323 read with Section 34 of the IPC.
The petitioner and the respondent No.2 are husband and wife.
The matter has been referred for mediation.
In the mediation, the matter has been settled between the parties.
A memorandum of settlement agreement has been entered into between the parties.

The respondent No.2 stated that she has no objection in quashing all further proceedings against the petitioner in C.C.No. 885/2011 refiled as C.C.No.1233/2017 on the files of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class-I,
Prappanangadi on the basis of the settlement.

entities.text:

sentences.text: Hence, all further proceedings pursuant to Annexure A2 final report in C.C.No.885/2011 refiled as C.C.No.1233/2017 on the files of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class-I, Parappanangadi is hereby quashed.
